description.narrative: Core support will be granted based on the RAF and the strategic budget submitted by Center Contact. The RAF is designed for 2021 - 2024. Almost the entire strategic cycle will be covered by Swedish support (implementation period is planed to be until June 2024). The objectives, indicators and measures of implementation are described clearly in the RAF and the institutional budget. Organisation`s mission is: strengthening civil society and promoting participatory democracy. It realises its mission by: implementing the initiatives for enhancing capacities of NGOs from different regions of the country, encouraging the networks and joint initiatives, raising of awareness of the wide public and decision makers regarding participatory democracy. Contact`s activity in the next four years (2021-2024) will focus on initiatives aiming to achieve the following results: 1. improved organizational capacity of CSOs from Moldova (including left bank of Nistru river/Transnistria) to pursue its goals and to become resilient; 2. changed attitudes and increased participation to local democratic processes (participatory democracy for all); 3. increased level of professionalism, financial sustainability and positive image of the Center Contact. During the implementation period there will be organized training sessions, mentorship, events, it will be published diverse informative and analytical materials, there will be organized small grants competitions. It is expected this to contribute to a development of the civil society in the country and a more active participation in decision making.

Sverige kommer att stödja Contact, en civil organisation från Moldavien, för genomförandet av kärnstödsaktiviteter fron Strategiska plan och RAF under 2021 – 2024. Syftet med det kärnstödet är att stärka organisationens kapacitet och utveckla deras interna regelverk. Contact utvecklar institutionell kapacitet, interna rutiner, personalkunskaper och andra färdigheter.
Kärnstöd beviljas för att stärka den institutionella kapaciteten och för att stödja genomförandet av Contact medellång sikt Strategisk plan 2021—2024. Huvudmålet och det förväntade resultatet av kärnverksamheten är att Contact bidrar till att utveckla kapaciteten hos icke-statliga organisationer från alla regioner i Moldavien.
Under den förberedande processen för insatsen, så har Sida’s principer och centrala prioriteringar för samarbetet med civilsamhällesorganisationer diskuterats med partnern. Contact ställer sig bakom Sidas gemensamma utgångspunkter för samarbete. Ambassaden tillsammans med Contact kommer att ha en kontinuerlig, öppen och transparent dialog om etiska och andra värdebaserade frågor.
Insatsens totala budget uppgår till 4 769 629 SEK.

Sweden will support Contact, a civil society organization from Moldova, to implement core support activities from Strategic Plan and RAF during 2021 - 2024. It is a contribution which aims at supporting the organization to develop its internal capacities and policies. Contact will develop institutional capacities, internal routines, staff knowledge and skills.
Core support is granted to strengthen institutional capacities and to assist the implementation of Contact medium term Strategic Plan 2021-2024. The main objective and expected result of core activities is that Contact contributes to developing the capacities of NGOs from all regions of Moldova.
Principal values for Sida and cooperation partners were shared and discussed as guidance during initial consultations on the contribution/project between programme coordinator and organization. Contact is open to endorse Sida's common starting points for cooperation. The Embassy will have a continuous, open and transparent dialogue on ethical and other value based issues.
The interventions' total budget is 4 769 629 SEK.

title.narrative: Decision on Contribution Core Support for Contact Center

description.narrative:
/2021/ The Centre has initiated the first edition of the NGOs Development Programme in Moldova - "reSTART". Within this programme 20 representatives of 19 CSOs from 14 districts/municipalities of the country were trained in areas such as: Organizational and functional framework; Planning, monitoring, evaluation and reporting; Financial and human resources management; Effective promotion of public image, external and partnership communication. In 2021, the CONTACT Centre continued to support social entrepreneurship in EU-supported projects. Also, the activities of the Platform for Philanthropy Development and Promotion (PPDF) were supported by the Center. It still provides the secretariat of the PPDF. In 2021, more than 100 CSOs from both sides of the Dniester River benefited from financial management consultancy assistance within the organization, of which more than 30 CSOs were able to develop existing financial management policies (procurement policies, accounting policies, etc.). CONTACT Centre has undertaken actions to promote the voluntary sector, informing about the activities of CSOs in Moldova. To this end, in 2021, CONTACT established collaborative relationships with more than 10 national media outlets, which promoted topics of public interest and the actions of civil society in Moldova. Topics such as the need to diversify the financial resources of civil society (philanthropy, social entrepreneurship, 2% mechanism), participatory budgeting, development of NGOs and civil society involvement in solving local problems, etc., were covered in more than 50 TV, radio, web, print media materials. It was also provided direct support to over 20 CSOs in developing visibility through the development of internal transparency policies and the preparation and publication of annual reports. During the year, it were continued the civil society advocacy activities as active members of the Platform for the Promotion and Development of Philanthropy, the NGO Council and the Coalition for Free and Fair Elections. In addition, the Center supported the activities of civil society platforms such as the Platform for Social Entrepreneurship Development, the Platform for Employment and the Platform for Trade. For members of these platforms, it were provided intensive advocacy training and help to implement their advocacy plans. In the area of participatory democracy in 2021, the organization focused on strengthening women and men's participation in participatory budgeting by creating local coalitions for participatory budgeting in 5 communities in the Security Zone. In 2021 it were undertook actions to involve women in politics in the Gagauzia ATU. CONTACT Centre trained over 60 women in active involvement with a view to their participation in the Gagauzia People's Assembly elections in September 2021.
/2022/ In 2022 CONTACT Centre continued the CSOs Development Programme - "reSTART". Within this programme 20 representatives of 16 CSOs and initiatives groups from different regions of the country were capacitated in areas such as: Organizational development; Planning, monitoring, evaluation and reporting; Financial and human resources management; Effective promotion of public image, external and partnership communication. In 2022, the organization continued a campaign to promote social entrepreneurship in Moldova, involving media institutions and publishing more different materials on the topic. The Platform for Development and Promotion of Philanthropy (PPDF) was supported during the year. CONTACT Center contributed to amending the law on Philanthropy and Sponsorship. In order to promote philanthropy in Moldova, together with Platform members, CONTACT Center organized the second campaign to promote philanthropy in Moldova. In 2022, more than 50 CSOs from both sides of the Dniester River improved their financial capacities, benefited from financial management consultancy assistance within the organization. Direct support was provided to over 20 CSOs in developing visibility through the development of internal transparency policies and the preparation and publication of annual reports. CSO Web Portal www.ngo.md was launched, a new database of active CSOs in Moldova. Together with the NGO Council in 2022, with the support of GIZ and Sida, the 11 th Edition of the National NGO Forum was organized, which was attended by more than 100 NGO representatives from both national and Eastern Partnership countries. Given the fact that all areas of economic and social life are moving to a digital standard and civil society must keep up with these changes, in 2022 it was organized the first National Conference on Digital Transformation of Civil Society, which allowed to develop a roadmap of actions aimed at the digital transformation of civil society in the Republic of Moldova Also in 2022, it was organized the second edition of the Community Leader Academy, which was attended by more than 40 leaders from different regions of Moldova. This year, for the first time, CONTACT organized a session of the Academy in Russian language to give national minorities an opportunity to participate. At the end of the Academy, 12 leaders' initiatives wee supported to mobilize citizens and address community issues.
/2023/ Impact area A: Activities of CONTACT Centre were focused on: strengthen and develop the capacities of CSOs, including in Transnistria region, in diversifying funding sources and fundraising, by organizing training and coaching programs; CSOs were assisted to develop and implement internal policies and procedures that ensure a higher level of financial management; contribution to development of legislation in the field of philanthropy, social entrepreneurship, financing of CSOs from public funds, as well as in ensuring an environment favorable to the functioning of CSOs (taxation, VAT, financial reporting, etc.); development and promotion of the concept of CSO self-regulation; capacity development of the CSO to promote their events; organize events to encourage transparent CSOs; conduct research on the impact of CSO on the development of the country, in order to increase the importance of the CSO as an important player and segment in the development of the country. Impact area B: Activities of CONTACT Centre were focused on: increasing the degree of interaction and collaboration activities between women / men and Local Authorities; providing the opportunities for advice and support the ideas for development and community involvement, so as to help beneficiaries understand and gain experience in civic activism and involvement in decision-making; providing individual assistance and financial support for the implementation of some community actions; promoting success stories that reflect the most relevant community issues that have been solved through civic activism and collaboration with LPA; strengthen capacities of local public authorities of ensuring transparent decision-making and access to information are. The impact area C focused on the development of the CONTACT Centre, by increasing the professionalism, efficiency and effectiveness of the team and internal processes as well as, promoting organizational values and culture within the organization. At the same time, the focus was devoted to improving the good governance and financial management & sustainability policies, with on-going development and diversification of the sources of funding. A big effort was made on growing visibility of the CONTACT Centre, and communication with their constituencies.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
